> Dispo-Concept Private Limited is a Bengaluru-based (published address: No.103, Siddalingeshwara Complex, Kempapura Road, Chikkabanavara, Bangalore – 560 090, Karnataka, India) medical-products business focused on surgical and procedural supplies, product sourcing and institutional supply. Product families: disposable surgical gowns (standard, reinforced BVB, double-layer), procedure kits (general surgery, delivery, urology, orthopaedic, cardiac configurations), 2-ply and 3-ply medical face masks, disposable medical caps, shoe covers, sterilization wraps, and custom-configured procedural packs. Supply role (manufactured, sourced or partner-produced) is confirmed per order. Operating model: documentation-first with Swiss-grade process discipline (a company-stated methodology, not a certification) — specifications, order records and commitments are written down and confirmed before dispatch, and enquiries follow a seven-step quality-gate framework. Official quotations, prices, MOQs, lead times and availability are confirmed ONLY through the RFQ (Request for Quotation) pathway.
>

## Policies
- No prices, MOQs, stock levels, lead-time promises or financial figures are published on this website.
- No certification claims (ISO 13485, CE, MDR) are published until each certificate has been verified for the relevant entity and product scope.
- Imagery is illustrative; it does not depict company facilities unless explicitly stated.
- Content is available in English, French, German, Spanish, Dutch, Arabic and Simplified Chinese.
- The full machine-readable version of this content is at https://dispoconceptpvtltd.com/llms-full.txt.
